subject: Governance Quarantine Format v1.0 — Formal Specification Delivery
body:
Authority delivers the governance quarantine format specification to Control Plane for integration.

This format resolves CP P6 audit weak point #3 (GUARD_RESULT: CORRUPT unrecoverable). The format defines:

1. Directory convention: lanes/{lane}/quarantine/governance/{timestamp}_{manifest_id}/
2. Manifest schema: schemas/quarantine-manifest-v1.json (formal JSON Schema)
3. 8 reason categories: CORRUPT, VERIFICATION_FAILED, SIGNATURE_INVALID, SCHEMA_INVALID, UNDER_ADJUDICATION, DRIFT_DETECTED, ORPHANED, UNKNOWN
4. 4 recovery statuses: BLOCKED (needs operator/authority), RECOVERABLE (re-verification may clear), ESCALATED (under adjudication), RESOLVED (recovered)
5. Tombstone markers at original path with manifest_id reference
6. Escalation rules: BLOCKED 24hr->P1, ESCALATED 48hr->P0, 3+ same-file quarantines->P0+root-cause
7. CP integration guide: Write-GuardedReport auto-quarantine on exit 3, preflight .quarantined tombstone checks, status includes quarantine count, observer NACK loop detection

Two deliverable files:
- S:/.global/GOVERNANCE_QUARANTINE_FORMAT.md — full specification
- S:/Archivist-Agent/schemas/quarantine-manifest-v1.json — formal JSON Schema

CP SHOULD integrate this format into cp-preflight.ps1, cp-supervise.ps1, and cp-lane-observer.ps1 as described in Section 7 (CP Integration Guide) of the format document.

Ratification conditions C1-C4 from GOV-RATIFY-001 remain binding.

Formal JSON Schema for quarantine manifest
